title: The Sullied Masked Hero
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro, Ran, Megure, Takagi, the Detective Boys) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities actually involved. case_type: murder. The old cases/ file had the correct culprit (Ushigome) and a roughly correct one-line motive, so no culprit correction was needed, but it was thin: it collapsed all suspect ties to generic 'knows' edges, had only 1 object node (missing the knife, gloves/jersey, spare jersey, hidden camera, and videotape entirely), had only 2 clue nodes where the transcript actually supports 5 distinct comparative clues (mask design mismatch red herring, doubled mask-strings, hair-vs-fingernail forensic contradiction, behavioral gait/glancing tell, and the inner mask's blood-splotch match), and omitted three named characters who matter to the plot: Kiba-san (the star whose match all four suspects claim to have been watching, giving the alibi structure its shape), Kayama (a minor bystander wrestler whose bloodied, bandaged appearance from an earlier bout is why nobody blinked at Ushigome's own blood-soaked jersey backstage), and Rossi's backstory as Ogami's former opponent (Mascara contra mascara) recruited by Kiba to re-debut as Nega Wolf. Also missing was Ushigome's second motive: he confesses he intended to pin the murder on Ogami specifically (using an old mask already carrying Ogami's hair) to get Ogami discredited/fired and seize the Wolf-Face identity for himself, on top of the revenge motive against Nagase's planned mid-match unmasking and defection to the rival Worldwide Pro Wrestlers promotion.

clues.desc: Video mask lacks the rear fur tufts present on Ogami's current mask -- a mismatch that turns out to be irrelevant, since it's just an older mask from the same storage bag.
The mask on the video shows four strings tied at the back instead of the normal two, revealing a second mask worn stacked underneath.
Hair inside the torn outer mask matches only Ogami, yet the victim's fingernails -- which tore that mask -- show no trace of the wearer's skin.
The culprit repeatedly glances around and stumbles on the tape, unlike the practiced, unhesitating movement of mask-wearers Ogami, Rossi, and Sakuma.
Blood on the inner mealtime mask sits exactly where the outer mask was torn, tying the hidden inner mask to the stabbing.

edges.attack_plan: target Ogami's not-fully-healed left knee, or tear his mask off if losing
